description: This script parses package index files for OpenWRT, converting them into a JSON format suitable for downstream tools. It supports both APK and opkg package formats and extracts package names and versions, handling ABI version suffixes.

methods.name: removesuffix(src, suffix)
methods.description: Removes a specified suffix from a string, compatible with Python versions earlier than 3.9.

methods.name: parse_args()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to configure architecture, source format, input file, and output options.

methods.name: dict parse_apk(text: str)
methods.description: Parses APK format package data from JSON text into a dictionary of package names and versions.

methods.name: dict parse_opkg(text: str)
methods.description: Parses opkg format package data from text into a dictionary of package names and versions.

search-terms: Python script for package index conversion

ctags.name: input
ctags.pattern: /^    input = sys.stdin if args.source == "-" else open(args.source, "r")$/

ctags.name: packages
ctags.pattern: /^    packages = parse_apk(text) if args.source_format == "apk" else parse_opkg(text)$/

fields.name: input = sys.stdin if args.source == "-" else open(args.source, "r")
packages = parse_apk(text) if args.source_format == "apk" else parse_opkg(text)
